direction.camera: Guide attention with mobile viewport; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: use one mobile-sized screen and one explicit interaction route; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.

direction.typography: Use mobile viewport,gesture path,close framing,clear tap,screen continuity,light depth as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
